summary.name: RUMIN Illustrative Sample Network
summary.description: A small, curated network used to demonstrate RUMIN's data model and financial network visualisation. It connects fictional companies to real-world industry classifications, countries and economic-variable definitions through illustrative relationships.
summary.provenance_note: Countries (ISO 3166-1 / ISO 4217 codes), industry classifications (ISIC Rev. 4) and the definitions of economic variables refer to real-world concepts; each carries a reference to its authoritative publisher. All companies are fictional. All relationships, polarities and strengths are illustrative modelling assumptions written for demonstration: they are not empirical findings and have not been validated. The dataset contains no observed financial values, prices or time series.
summary.license: Authored for the RUMIN project. Contains no third-party data values.

capabilities.label: Reference data
capabilities.note: Illustrative sample dataset: fictional companies linked to real-world classifications and variable definitions.

capabilities.label: Financial network
capabilities.note: Graph projection of entities, curated relationships and structural links.

capabilities.label: Versioned scenarios
capabilities.note: Scenarios are saved as immutable, numbered versions: a save never overwrites, and an executed version can never change.

capabilities.label: Scenario Lab
capabilities.note: Scenarios executed through five registered models, chosen by what each declares and what the knowledge graph states, with the modelled pathway, baseline against scenario, months, stress cases, sensitivity, comparison and explanations. Executions run on a bounded worker pool (2 at once, 8 waiting, 20-second limit) and are reproducible. Deterministic: no stochastic simulation.

capabilities.label: Historical observations
capabilities.note: Annual World Bank (WDI) series, retrieved with the ingestion command line and stored exactly as published, with every revision kept. Historical only: nothing is real-time.

capabilities.label: Licensed price files
capabilities.note: Daily prices from CSV files you are licensed to use, imported from the command line with a manifest stating the licence. RUMIN ships no price data.

capabilities.label: Data-quality checks
capabilities.note: Every record is validated: structural problems are rejected (and kept for review), unusual values are stored as reported and flagged. Nothing is corrected.

capabilities.label: Ingestion from the web app
capabilities.note: Retrievals and imports run from the command line; the API is read-only until authentication exists.

capabilities.label: Knowledge graph
capabilities.note: Entities, relationships and evidence built from the stored data, with entity resolution, validation and provenance on every edge. Built from the command line.

capabilities.label: Graph analytics
capabilities.note: Bounded neighbourhoods, shortest paths (in hops), connected components and degree. Paths show how records connect; they are not influence or causal chains.

capabilities.label: Simulation engine
capabilities.note: Five models in preview — airline fuel costs, foreign-currency revenue and costs, floating-rate interest, crude-oil-linked and gas-linked costs — calculated month by month from stated inputs and assumptions, with one-at-a-time sensitivity. Every run stores its inputs, graph snapshot and calculation steps. Results are calculations, not forecasts.

capabilities.label: Financial intelligence
capabilities.note: Insights built by documented rules from stored values, validated graph relationships and stored executions: detected changes, trends, volatility, unusual moves, revisions, exposure, contributions and cross-entity links. Each carries its evidence chain and grade; nothing is written by a language model and nothing is a forecast.

capabilities.label: Probabilistic simulation
capabilities.note: Not implemented: runs are deterministic and no probabilities are estimated. Sensitivity analysis shows how results move with each input, not how likely they are.

capabilities.label: AI analyst
capabilities.note: No AI model is connected. The intelligence engine already prepares the structured brief an analyst would narrate, with every number computed by RUMIN.

capabilities.label: Authentication
capabilities.note: Not implemented. Run this build locally only.

capabilities.label: Live market data
capabilities.note: Not connected. RUMIN makes no real-time data claims.
